_readme: COPY THIS FILE, name the copy credentials.json (same folder), then fill in the sign-in
details for each store you have a test account for.
Windows hides file extensions by default: if the copy shows up as just 'credentials',
rename it to 'credentials' - typing 'credentials.json' there makes it credentials.json.json,
which is never read (the tests print a warning if they find one).
credentials.json is gitignored and must NEVER be committed, emailed, or put in a shared
folder. Ask whoever set this up for the values - they live in the QA password manager,
Leave a store as null, or leave REPLACE_ME in place, and that store's checkout test simply
shows as skipped. That is not a failure - everything else still runs.
Environment variables override this file, per field:
CHECKOUT_EMAIL_BESTUS / CHECKOUT_PASSWORD_BESTUS   (and likewise for the other codes)
On a shared or network-drive deployment, put your copy at
instead, so it is not readable by everyone with access to the share.
